tools.name: site_info
tools.description: What Black Label Bots (blacklabelbots.com) is, with links to its sitemap, docs, contact and every discovery document.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Find pages on blacklabelbots.com by words in their URL path (sitemap search). Returns URLs with a match score.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one https://blacklabelbots.com page as Markdown (Cloudflare Markdown for Agents) or stripped text, up to 40,000 characters.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Everything an agent can buy from Black Label Bots, with Stripe-verified prices, billing terms, delivery and live availability.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start a purchase of one offer. Returns a continue_url: send the buyer there to pay on the Stripe-hosted checkout page. This tool does not charge anything.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Read a checkout started with create_checkout.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Read current website service prices, availability and payment requirements. Free; does not request payment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_pages, run_ai_search_audit, run_structured_data_pack, run_llms_txt_draft · Private data: site_info, run_ai_search_audit, run_structured_data_pack, run_llms_txt_draft · Public sink: create_checkout, run_ai_search_audit, run_structured_data_pack, run_llms_txt_draft · Destructive: run_ai_search_audit, run_structured_data_pack, run_llms_txt_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_pages, run_ai_search_audit, run_structured_data_pack, run_llms_txt_draft · Private data: site_info, run_ai_search_audit, run_structured_data_pack, run_llms_txt_draft · Public sink: create_checkout, run_ai_search_audit, run_structured_data_pack, run_llms_txt_draft · Destructive: run_ai_search_audit, run_structured_data_pack, run_llms_txt_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
